subject.title: Write tool lacks append mode — isolated cron sessions destroy shared files

question: Should OpenClaw make first-class append semantics part of the built-in write tool contract for ordinary agent, cron, and monitor workflows?
rationale: The source-level problem is clear, but the fix changes a model-facing and extension-observable core tool API, so automation should not choose the permanent contract shape without maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept append on write
options.body: Land the linked approach after explicitly accepting `append?: boolean` and the matching backend append operation as the supported write-tool contract.

options.title: Use a separate append surface
options.body: Ask for a narrower replacement using `mode: "append"` or a dedicated append tool if maintainers do not want `write` to grow an optional boolean.

options.title: Keep overwrite-only for now
options.body: Leave the core tool unchanged and document `exec >>` or plugin-level workarounds, accepting the continued data-loss risk for general agent writes.

recommendation.title: Accept append on write
recommendation.body: Land the linked approach after explicitly accepting `append?: boolean` and the matching backend append operation as the supported write-tool contract.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a core product/API choice and this handle is both the documented maintainer and a recent owner of the shared agent runtime/tool surface.
